title: Reference interpreters and semantic conformance harness
acceptance: Reference fixtures cover all provider kinds, risk classes, memory modes, receipt levels, and tool lifecycle states.
Any production/reference mismatch fails tests with human-readable diff.
The testkit is dependency-light and does not call production internals in a circular way.
forbidden: Do not make the reference interpreter a thin wrapper around production code.
Do not bless implementation behavior by copying its bugs into fixtures.
